A crime-plagued future becomes a battlefield in Kill Code, a cyberpunk sci-fi action thriller where justice has been turned into a weapon.

After a powerful corporation takes control of the prison system, criminals are forced into a deadly new order through lethal wristwatch technology designed to make them hunt each other for freedom. But when one fighter uncovers the truth behind the system, the fight for survival becomes a full-scale rebellion against the people controlling it.

Starring Franzi Schissler, Harvey Keitel, Tyrese Gibson, and Frank Grillo, Kill Code delivers a violent near-future world of surveillance, corporate control, criminal warfare, and explosive sci-fi action.
